judgments.reason: The model never describes the mechanism that the three-coin commission is applied before payment or that overbidding beyond available coins can win; its articulation only states a bid and expected net profit, not the claimed rule-order effect.

Although the transcript shows clerk revelations, the model articulation does not state the mechanism that waiting reveals committed rival bids prior to your commitment; the model only reports waiting behavior without explaining that revelation timing.
The model articulation does not claim or explain that a close action settles the game even with unauctioned lots; it only describes waiting and bidding behavior, not this terminal rule mechanism.

The model never articulates a mechanism where catalog purchases receive the auction three-coin commission; it explicitly notes catalog items are not auction wins but gives no mechanism substituting the commission to purchases.
